text.name: sdt_status_notAllowed

text.name: sdt_warning_obstacleTooHigh

text.text: The contract on this field does not allow spraying

text.name: sdt_warning_missionProduct
text.text: The contract needs a different product than the trailer holds

text.name: sdt_warning_missionRunning
text.text: The drone is flying – change the field after it returns

text.name: sdt_warning_outOfRange
text.text: The field is out of drone range

text.name: sdt_warning_droneFlying
text.text: The drone is airborne – returning, fold after it lands

text.text: No room for the landing pad, something is in the way

text.name: sdt_warning_padSlope
text.text: The ground is too steep for the landing pad

text.name: sdt_warning_padHigh
text.text: The ground is higher than the trailer deck, the pad cannot slide out

text.name: sdt_warning_padHose
text.text: The hose would not reach the drone on the pad

text.name: sdt_planner_hintSelect
text.text: Click a field with a blue or gold outline inside the range circle.

text.name: sdt_planner_battery
text.text: Battery: up to %.0f %% per batch, battery swaps %d

text.name: sdt_planner_batteryLife
text.text: Battery life %.0f min with a full tank, %.0f min empty

text.name: sdt_planner_tooHigh
text.text: An obstacle on the way exceeds the %.0f m limit – move the trailer.

text.name: sdt_planner_notEnough
text.text: Not enough product for the whole field – the drone stops when the trailer is empty.

text.name: sdt_planner_clipped
text.text: Part of the field is out of range – the route covers only the part inside the circle.

text.name: sdt_planner_returning
text.text: The drone is returning to the trailer

text.name: sdt_planner_highestPoint
text.text: Highest point on the path: %.0f m above terrain

text.name: sdt_planner_highestPointNone
text.text: Highest point on the path: no obstacle

text.name: sdt_planner_legend
text.text: The selected field is outlined in green, the flight area in purple. Route line colors = batches, thin = turn between rows. Red marks the part of the field that was not planned because of diesel or battery.

text.name: sdt_planner_controls
text.text: Click = select field, drag = pan map, wheel = zoom.

text.name: sdt_status_areaNoPath
text.text: Drone: the flight area does not connect the trailer with the field – edit or delete it

text.name: sdt_planner_areaNeedField
text.text: Select a field first – the flight area belongs to a field

text.name: sdt_planner_fieldReset
text.text: Drone progress cleared – it will fly the field from the start

text.name: sdt_planner_areaDeleted
text.text: Flight area deleted – the drone flies directly

text.name: sdt_planner_areaCancelled
text.text: Drawing cancelled, the area is unchanged

text.name: sdt_planner_areaMaxPoints
text.text: The area can have at most %d points

text.name: sdt_planner_flightArea
text.text: Flight area: %d points (transit only inside it or over the field)

text.name: sdt_planner_areaHomeOutside
text.text: The trailer is outside the flight area – cannot fly.

text.name: sdt_planner_areaNoPath
text.text: The flight area does not connect the trailer with the field – cannot fly.

text.name: sdt_planner_areaFix
text.text: Edit the area so it contains the trailer and reaches the field, or delete it.

text.name: sdt_planner_transitLength
text.text: Direct transit: out %.0f m, back %.0f m (1st batch), total %.1f km

text.name: sdt_planner_transitLengthArea
text.text: Transit via area: out %.0f m, back %.0f m (1st batch), total %.1f km

text.name: sdt_planner_drawHint
text.text: Outline a path from the trailer to the field around buildings and trees. Click the first point to close the area.

text.name: sdt_planner_controlsDraw
text.text: Click = add point, drag = pan map, wheel = zoom.

text.name: sdt_gps_rtk
text.text: Precision GPS with RTK (15% less spray)

text.name: sdt_relaySlot_full
text.text: No free pole holder on the trailer

text.name: sdt_relaySlot_unfolded
text.text: Fold the pole before storing it

text.name: sdt_relaySlot_powered
text.text: Switch the pole off before storing it

text.name: sdt_relaySlot_noPole
text.text: This pole cannot be stored right now

text.name: sdt_relaySlot_spawnFailed
text.text: The pole could not be taken out, it stays on the trailer

text.name: sdt_status_outOfReach
text.text: Drone: the rest of the field is out of range or signal – move the trailer or relay and start again

text.name: sdt_state_waitRelay
text.text: waiting for relay – pole battery low

text.name: sdt_relay_blockedDrone
text.text: The pole is relaying a flying drone

text.name: sdt_hud_noPowerFuel
text.text: the generator is out of diesel

text.name: sdt_planner_legendSignal
text.text: Cyan marks the trailer's signal range, orange the range of switched-on relay poles linked to the trailer (thin circle = how far the drone can fly on its battery). Colored pole icon = on, gray = off or folded.

text.name: sdt_relayPole_function
text.text: Extends the radio range of a drone trailer. Stand it upright on the ground within range of the trailer and unfold it (R). Enter it (E) and switch it on (B); the battery shows at the bottom right. The battery lasts about 5 hours and charges on a trailer with a running generator or at a charging station.

text.name: sdt_droneTablet_function
text.text: Mobile controller: held in hand, R opens the planner of a trailer in range and lets you start and control a mission remotely.

text.name: sdt_hud_draining
text.text: Draining drone into trailer: %.0f l/min, %.1f l left in drone

text.name: sdt_state_mixing
text.text: filling tank and mixing product (%.0f l/min)

text.name: sdt_state_mixingSwapping
text.text: filling tank, mixing product and swapping battery

text.name: sdt_status_noConcentrate
text.text: Drone: the main tank holds water but the concentrate tank is empty

text.name: sdt_status_noWater
text.text: Drone: the concentrate tank is filled but the main tank has no water to mix with

text.name: sdt_hud_mixing
text.text: Mixing: %.0f %% concentrate · water %.0f l · concentrate %.0f l

text.name: sdt_hud_noConcentrate
text.text: Main tank holds water – concentrate missing

text.name: sdt_hud_noWater
text.text: No water in the main tank for mixing

text.name: sdt_planner_noConcentrate
text.text: No concentrate: the main tank holds water but the concentrate tank is empty (or holds neither fertilizer nor herbicide).

text.name: sdt_planner_noWater
text.text: No water: the concentrate tank is filled but the main tank is empty.

text.name: sdt_hud_pumpingToPallet
text.text: Pumping into IBC: %.0f l/min, %.0f l left in trailer

text.name: sdt_warning_noPallet
text.text: No IBC within %.0f m of the trailer that accepts its product

text.name: sdt_planner_settingsHint
text.text: Click – / + or scroll over a row; click a row to select it, then the Lower / Raise selected buttons below change it. Range is recomputed from the battery.

text.name: sdt_warning_foldFirst
text.text: Fold the trailer first (it cannot be attached or detached while unfolded)

text.name: sdt_warning_noDrone
text.text: The trailer has no drone – buy one in the workshop (Customize)

text.name: sdt_warning_noBatteries
text.text: The drone has no battery and cannot take off – buy batteries in the workshop (Customize)

text.name: sdt_hud_noDrone
text.text: Trailer without a drone (buy one in the workshop)

text.name: sdt_hud_droneNoField
text.text: Drone: %s · no field, open the planner

text.name: sdt_toolbox_dlgNothing
text.text: The toolbox holds no canisters and the concentrate tank is empty – to store a canister, open the toolbox (left click) and let go of the canister over it

text.text: There is no canister in the slot

text.name: sdt_toolbox_noCanisterItem
text.text: A canister of this kind cannot be created

text.name: sdt_toolbox_spawnLimit
text.text: The pallet and object limit is reached, the item cannot be created

text.name: sdt_toolbox_spawnFailed
text.text: The canister could not be created, the contents stayed where they were

text.name: sdt_toolbox_noTank
text.text: The trailer has no concentrate tank

text.name: sdt_toolbox_tankMismatch
text.text: The concentrate tank holds a different substance – drain it into canisters first

text.name: sdt_toolbox_tankRejects
text.text: The concentrate tank does not accept this substance

text.name: sdt_toolbox_pourNoCanister
text.text: There is no canister at the tank filler

text.name: sdt_toolbox_typeNotAllowed
text.text: A canister does not take this substance

text.name: sdt_canister_function
text.text: Concentrate for the spray drone service trailer. Put the canister into the toolbox of the trailer and pour it into the concentrate tank; the mixer dilutes it with water from the main tank.

text.name: sdt_state_waitPad

text.text: Drone: the battery is not charging, the generator is switched off

text.name: sdt_action_groundDrainOn
text.text: Drain concentrate into canisters beside the trailer

text.name: sdt_warning_trailerUnfolded
text.text: The trailer is unfolded and holds the vehicle in place. Fold it to drive away.

text.name: sdt_status_trailerMoved
text.text: Drone: the trailer moved, flight aborted

text.name: sdt_warning_tilt
text.text: The trailer stands too tilted (lengthwise %+.1f°, sideways %+.1f°, at most %.0f°) – park it on more level ground
